rca_of_issue: Email duplicate-key bug RCA: /app/backend/server.py:90 declares db.users.create_index('email', unique=True, sparse=True). Both create_user() (line 626-635) and set_user_email() (line 606) persist email as null when the input is empty. Sparse index only skips documents that OMIT the field; a document with email=null still occupies the index key (null). Thus the second insert/update with email=null violates uniqueness and raises pymongo.errors.DuplicateKeyError, returned to client as HTTP 500. Repro: POST /api/users with no email (ok, admin had no email key) -> POST /api/users again with no email -> 500. Mitigation: either use partialFilterExpression={'email': {'$type': 'string'}} on index creation, or in Python set the document to NOT include an 'email' key when empty (and $unset in update).
